== Summary ==
Title banner for [[Virtual Block 1]] ("A New Hope"), from the cover page of the Virtual Block 1: A New Hope PDF. Its cover reads "Official text as of December 7, 2009". The file was created on 18 December 2009.

Source: [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock1.pdf VirtualBlock1.pdf], res.starwarsccg.org. Page 1 rendered at 158 dpi, the resolution of the embedded cover image, and cropped to the banner (1028&times;633 pixels). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008195542/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock1.pdf Internet Archive].
